meta.name: story-long-scan
meta.description: 长篇网文扫榜。分析起点、番茄、晋江等平台排行榜数据，提炼市场趋势与热门题材。触发方式：/story-long-scan、/长篇扫榜、「长篇什么火」「起点排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 抓取起点、番茄、晋江等平台排行，告诉你长篇网文眼下什么题材最火。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在写长篇网文，想跟上各平台的热门题材走向。
copy.tagline_en: Scan Qidian, Fanqie and Jinjiang rankings to reveal which web-novel genres are trending.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write serial web fiction and want to track hot genres.

howto.what: Claude 会以网文市场分析师的身份，采集起点、番茄、晋江等平台的排行榜数据，产出扫榜报告（题材热度、新题材信号、书名与标签规律）和 2-3 个带可行性、失败风险的选题建议。
howto.when: 当你说出 /story-long-scan、/长篇扫榜，或问「长篇什么火」「起点排行」时触发。

say.text: 帮我扫一下起点排行榜，看看最近什么题材火
say.note: 会先问你平台和方向，再采集数据

say.text: 把番茄男频阅读榜扫一遍，出一份扫榜报告
say.note: 没给现成数据时它会尝试脚本采集

say.text: 根据扫榜结果给我 2 个能写的选题方向
say.note: 会附可行性判断和验证动作

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a web-novel market analyst. It collects ranking data from Qidian, Fanqie and Jinjiang, then produces a scan report (genre heat, new-genre signals, title and tag patterns) plus 2-3 topic picks with feasibility and failure risk.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you call /story-long-scan or /长篇扫榜, or ask things like which long-form genres are hot, or ask about Qidian rankings.

say_en.text: Scan the Qidian rankings and tell me which genres are hot
say_en.note: It asks for platform and direction first, then collects data.

say_en.text: Scan the Fanqie male reading rank and give me a scan report
say_en.note: If no data is given, it tries script collection.

say_en.text: Based on the scan, give me 2 writable topic directions
say_en.note: Each comes with feasibility and a validation step.
